title: Filtered Outbox
description: An admin investigating a support ticket needs to pull up exactly one customer's message history, not wade through everyone else's. Confirm the outbox's recipient filter is exact, not a fuzzy or partial match.
successCondition: Trigger notify-worthy actions (e.g. bookings) for two customers with clearly distinct emails. After waiting past the queue delay, GET /api/notifications/outbox?to=<customerA's exact email> as admin returns only messages where every entry's to field equals that exact email — none belonging to customer B. GET /api/notifications/outbox with no to param at all returns messages for both customers.
hints: The filter is a plain Prisma where: { to } equality match — there's no partial/substring matching, so a query with a truncated or differently-cased email should return zero matches for that customer's messages, worth trying as a follow-up.
Give the two customers emails that don't share a common substring, so a passing test can't be accidentally explained by a fuzzy match you didn't intend to allow.
